That clarification improves precision, but it does not satisfy the missing compliance predicates. On the current record, admissible evidence shows aggregate performance clears the deployment threshold, the small-business support slice underperforms, the slice result has higher uncertainty, the policy requires disclosure of material weaknesses unless an approved mitigation removes exposure, and the draft mitigation is unapproved. Because those are unresolved predicates for certification rather than mere presentational caveats, the narrowed argument is not enough to move the assessment to compliant_with_caveats.
